descriptionPlain: Coordinate product planning across research, design, engineering, and customer success. Improve launch readiness, gather customer feedback, and maintain clear operating processes for product teams.

lists.content:
• Facilitate quarterly planning and weekly product reviews.
  • Build launch checklists and communicate risks to stakeholders.
  • Use customer insights and operating data to improve team workflows.

• Five years of product operations or program management experience.
  • Strong written communication and cross-functional collaboration.
